name: pipeline
facts: The pipeline has six phases, numbered 0 through 5
Phase 0 scopes the corpus and loads the most recent prior report for trend diffing
The /insights gate is judged on recency and never on coverage percentage, because /insights samples recent sessions rather than the whole corpus
Phase 2 triages every in-window session from cheap metadata before agent tokens are spent
Phase 3 fans out to extract, clusters the signals, decides a verdict per cluster, then corroborates against the /insights facet data
Phase 4 writes one self-contained HTML report with inline SVG graphics and no external requests
Phase 5 delivers the report with the top recommendations and anything the run had to skip
